First, load in the water supply database. 
We are only performing this rapid assessment on CONUS water supplies that are not municipal or hauled water supplies.
```{r}
# parks <- get_park_system()
# read in pre-saved park file
suppressMessages(parks <- st_read("data/rapid/inputs/park_boundaries_2025-08-14.gpkg"))

park_water_supplies <- parks %>% 
  st_centroid() %>% 
  st_transform(4326) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(y = st_coordinates(.)[,2], x = st_coordinates(.)[,1])

# Read in water supply database for filtered parks


table_path <- "data/Water_Supply_Systems/NPS_Water_Systems_Database_Joined.xlsx"


water_supplies <- read_excel(table_path,
                             sheet = 1,
                             na = c("NA", "U"),
                             skip = 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_longitude = as.numeric(source_longitude),
    source_latitude = as.numeric(source_latitude)
  ) %>%
  filter(!state %in% c("AK", "AS", "HI", "MP", "PR", "VI")) %>%
  left_join(
    park_water_supplies %>% 
      st_drop_geometry() %>% 
      dplyr::select(UNIT_CODE, x, y),
    by = c(park_unit = "UNIT_CODE")
  ) %>% dplyr::mutate(
    coords_flag = ifelse(
      is.na(source_longitude) |
        is.na(source_latitude),
      "Centroid",
      "Source Coordinates"
    ),
    source_longitude = ifelse(is.na(source_longitude), x, source_longitude),
    source_latitude = ifelse(is.na(source_latitude), y, source_latitude)
  ) %>%
  # remove municipal and hauled source types, accounting for database entry errors
  filter(!str_detect(source_type, regex("municipal|hauled", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  drop_na(source_longitude, source_latitude) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = (c("source_longitude", "source_latitude")),
           crs = 4326,
           remove = FALSE)
```

## Fisichelli et al. 2015 approach:
Grab all park visitation and temperature data, combine into one file.
We defined annual visitation levels as: low (10–399k visitors), medium (400–999 k visitors) and high (over 1 million visitors) as done in the NPS visitation study (Rappaport Keener et al., 2025)

##### Download temperature data

Download data from Pierce. Is split my tmin and tmax, and 30ish year time periods, so it's a lot of files. I've stored a list of all model/time/ssp combos to iterate over for the download.

Also download GridMET data (for later comparison).

Do once. takes forever.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# LOCA hindcast, historical, monthly
options(timeout = 1800)
urls <- readLines("data/dissertation/loca2_complete_tasmax_tasmin_urls.txt")
for(i in 1:length(urls)){
  download.file(urls[i], destfile = paste0("data/all/loca2_mwbm/", basename(urls[i])))
}

# GRIDMET
# Get unique sources with their geometries
unique_sources <- water_supplies %>%
  distinct(wsd_source_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(wsd_source_id, geometry)

# Create a 3x3 grid pattern
grid_positions <- tibble(
  direction = c("NW", "N", "NE", 
                "W", "Center", "E", 
                "SW", "S", "SE"),
  x_offset = c(-1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 1),
  y_offset = c(1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1, -1, -1)
)

# Distance in meters (4 km)
distance_m <- 4000

# Transform to a projected CRS for accurate distance calculations
unique_sources_proj <- unique_sources %>%
  st_transform(crs = 5070)

# Create new points for each grid position
new_points <- grid_positions %>%
  filter(direction != "Center") %>%  # Exclude center since that's the original point
  crossing(unique_sources_proj) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate new point using x and y offsets
    new_geometry = st_sfc(
      st_point(
        c(
          st_coordinates(geometry)[1] + (x_offset * distance_m),
          st_coordinates(geometry)[2] + (y_offset * distance_m)
        )
      ),
      crs = 5070
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Drop the old geometry column and set the new one
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "new_geometry", crs = 5070) %>%
  # Transform back to WGS84
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
  # Create new IDs
  mutate(
    wsd_source_id_new = paste0(wsd_source_id, "_", direction),
    point_type = "buffer_point"
  ) %>%
  select(wsd_source_id_original = wsd_source_id, 
         wsd_source_id = wsd_source_id_new,
         direction,
         x_offset,
         y_offset,
         point_type,
         geometry = new_geometry)
# Optionally combine with original points
original_points <- unique_sources %>%
  mutate(
    wsd_source_id_original = wsd_source_id,
    direction = "Center",
    bearing = NA_real_,
    point_type = "original"
  ) %>%
  select(wsd_source_id_original, wsd_source_id, direction, bearing, point_type, geometry)

all_points <- bind_rows(original_points, new_points)

# gridMET download with {climateR}
for(i in 1:nrow(all_points)){
  
  unit <- all_points[i,]
  temp_data <- tibble()
  try(temp_data <- climateR::getGridMET(AOI = unit,
                                        varname = c("tmmx", "tmmn"),
                                        startDate = "1980-01-01",
                                        endDate = "2025-12-31") %>%
        mutate(month = lubridate::ym(substr(date, 1, 7))) %>%
        group_by(month) %>%
        summarize(tmean_C = ((mean(tmmn, na.rm = TRUE) + mean(tmmx, na.rm = TRUE))/2) - 273.15) %>%
        mutate(wsd_source_id = unit$wsd_source_id))
  
  arrow::write_parquet(temp_data, paste0("data/dissertation/gridmet_temperature_water_supplies/", unit$wsd_source_id, ".parquet"))
  
  Sys.sleep(1)
  
  print(unit$wsd_source_id)
  
}
```

Now that all have been downloaded, subset to only the models that were used in the MWBM? 
This is still a work in progress - not sure if it's working properly yet. But, ideally want to double check all models have been downloaded.

```{r, eval = TRUE}
# Parse model + scenario (ssp### or historical) + run from LOCA2 filenames
parse_gcm_bits <- function(x) {
  bn <- basename(x)
  
  m <- str_match(bn, "(?i)(?:^|[._-])([A-Za-z0-9-]+)[._-](historical|ssp\\d{3})[._-](r\\d+i\\d+p\\d+f\\d+)(?:[._-]|$)")
  
  tibble(file = x,
         model = m[, 2],
         scenario = tolower(m[, 3]),  # "ssp370" or "historical"
         run  = m[, 4]) %>%
    filter(!if_any(c(model, scenario, run), is.na)) %>%
    mutate(key_mr = str_c(model, run, sep = "|")) # match on model+run only
}

dir_in <- "data/all/loca2_mwbm/"

# files
runoff_files <- list.files(dir_in, pattern = "^runoff_MWBM_LOCA2", full.names = TRUE)
tasmin_files <- list.files(dir_in, pattern = "^tasmin\\.", full.names = TRUE)
tasmax_files <- list.files(dir_in, pattern = "^tasmax\\.", full.names = TRUE)

# runoff model + run combos (ignore scenario so we can also pull historical temps)
runoff_mr <- parse_gcm_bits(runoff_files) %>%
  distinct(key_mr, model, run)

# Keep tasmin/tasmax for:
#   - any (model, run) that exists in runoff
#   - AND for those, include BOTH historical + any ssp### that happen to be present
tasmin_match <- parse_gcm_bits(tasmin_files) %>%
  semi_join(runoff_mr %>% distinct(key_mr), by = "key_mr")

tasmax_match <- parse_gcm_bits(tasmax_files) %>%
  semi_join(runoff_mr %>% distinct(key_mr), by = "key_mr")

tasmin_keep <- tasmin_match$file
tasmax_keep <- tasmax_match$file

# tas files whose (model, run) aren't in runoff (extras)
tasmin_no_runoff_match <- parse_gcm_bits(tasmin_files) %>%
  anti_join(runoff_mr %>% distinct(key_mr), by = "key_mr") %>%
  pull(file)

tasmax_no_runoff_match <- parse_gcm_bits(tasmax_files) %>%
  anti_join(runoff_mr %>% distinct(key_mr), by = "key_mr") %>%
  pull(file)

# missing checks vs runoff (by scenario)
# "Do we have historical tasmin/tasmax for every runoff model+run?"
missing_hist_tasmin <- runoff_mr %>%
  anti_join(tasmin_match %>% filter(scenario == "historical") %>% distinct(key_mr),
            by = "key_mr") %>%
  arrange(model, run)

missing_hist_tasmax <- runoff_mr %>%
  anti_join(tasmax_match %>% filter(scenario == "historical") %>% distinct(key_mr),
            by = "key_mr") %>%
  arrange(model, run)

# "Do we have at least one ssp### tasmin/tasmax for every runoff model+run?"
missing_ssp_tasmin <- runoff_mr %>%
  anti_join(tasmin_match %>% filter(str_detect(scenario, "^ssp\\d{3}$")) %>% distinct(key_mr),
            by = "key_mr") %>%
  arrange(model, run)

missing_ssp_tasmax <- runoff_mr %>%
  anti_join(tasmax_match %>% filter(str_detect(scenario, "^ssp\\d{3}$")) %>% distinct(key_mr),
            by = "key_mr") %>%
  arrange(model, run)

# Optional: paired table (one row per model+run+scenario) with file paths
pairs <- full_join(tasmin_match %>% transmute(key_mr, model, run, scenario, tasmin_file = file),
                   tasmax_match %>% transmute(key_mr, model, run, scenario, tasmax_file = file),
                   by = c("key_mr","model","run","scenario")) %>%
  arrange(model, run, scenario)
```

##### Process temperature data

Grab the raw tmin and tmax model files and get the mean temp across each site's grid and its surrounding grids.

Do once. takes forever.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# "observed" loca2 temp data (already averaged)
process_loca2_mwbm(nc_path = "data/all/loca2_mwbm/jay_alder_tas_MWBM_LOCA2_training_195001-201412.nc",
                   output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_temperature_water_supplies/", 
                   water_supplies = water_supplies %>% select(wsd_source_id), 
                   var = "tas",
                   historical = c("1990-01-01", "2024-12-31"),
                   future = c("2025-01-01", "2100-12-31"))

# modeled loca2 data (tmin)
walk(list.files("data/all/loca2/", pattern = "tasmin.", full.names = TRUE),
     ~try(process_loca2_mwbm(.x, 
                             output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_temperature_water_supplies/", 
                             water_supplies = water_supplies %>% select(wsd_source_id), 
                             var = "tasmin_tavg",
                             historical = c("1990-01-01", "2024-12-31"),
                             future = c("2025-01-01", "2100-12-31"))))
# modeled loca2 data (tmax)
walk(list.files("data/all/loca2/", pattern = "tasmax.", full.names = TRUE),
     ~process_loca2_mwbm(.x, 
                         output_dir = "data/rapid/inputs/loca2_temperature_water_supplies/", 
                         water_supplies = water_supplies %>% select(wsd_source_id), 
                         var = "tasmax_tavg",
                         historical = c("1990-01-01", "2024-12-31"),
                         future = c("2025-01-01", "2100-12-31")))

# all files processed minus "observed" loca2 (denoted with "Jay"):
model_files <- grep("jay",
                    list.files("data/rapid/inputs/loca2_temperature_water_supplies", full.names = TRUE),
                    invert = TRUE,
                    value = TRUE)

# {data.table} approach at binding and averaging across tmax and tmin data sets to get average monthly temp per site:
out <- rbindlist(
  lapply(model_files, function(f) {
    dt <- as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(f))
    dt <- dt[, model := sub("^[^.]+\\.([^.]+\\.[^.]+\\.[^.]+)\\..*$", "\\1", basename(f))]
    
    # Aggregate immediately within this file
    dt <- dt[, .(
      mean  = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = .N
    ),
    by = .(wsd_source_id, date, model)
    ]
  }),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

arrow::write_parquet(out, "data/dissertation/loca2_temp_nps_water_supplies.parquet")
```

#### How different are GridMET and LOCA?
```{r}
# "Observed" gridmet temp
gridmet_temp <- unique(water_supplies$wsd_source_id) %>%
  map(~try({
    
    list.files("data/dissertation/gridmet_temperature_water_supplies/", pattern = paste(.x), full.names = TRUE) %>%
      map_dfr(~read_parquet(.x)) %>%
      group_by(month) %>%
      summarize(tmean_C = mean(tmean_C, na.rm = TRUE),
                n_points = n()) %>%
      mutate(wsd_source_id = .x)
    
    
  })) %>%
  keep(tibble::is_tibble) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  filter(year(month) >= 1990 & year(month) <= 2014) %>%
  rename(temp_gridmet = tmean_C) %>%
  mutate(month = as.character(npswava::make_ym(month)))

# "Observed" loca temp
loca_temp <- grep("jay", list.files("data/rapid/inputs/loca2_temperature_water_supplies", full.names = TRUE), invert = FALSE, value = TRUE) %>%
  map_dfr(~arrow::read_parquet(.x) %>% as.data.table()) %>%
  filter(year(date) >= 1990 & year(date) <= 2014)

setDT(loca_temp)

# 1) Find the most common lon/lat index pair per wsd_source_id (the center cell)
center_idx <- loca_temp[
  ,
  .N,
  by = .(wsd_source_id, lon_index, lat_index)
][
  order(wsd_source_id, -N)
][
  , .SD[1], by = wsd_source_id   # take top-count pair
][
  , .(wsd_source_id, lon_index, lat_index)
]

# 2) Semi-join to keep only those rows (center cell), preserving all dates/times
loca_center <- loca_temp[center_idx, on = .(wsd_source_id, lon_index, lat_index)] %>%
  select(month = date, 
         wsd_source_id,
         temp_loca = value) %>%
  mutate(month = npswava::make_ym(month)) 

temp_comp <- gridmet_temp %>%
  inner_join(loca_center, by = c("wsd_source_id", "month")) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

dt <- as.data.table(temp_comp)

dt[
  ,
  .(
    n     = .N,
    cor   = cor(temp_loca, temp_gridmet, use = "complete.obs"),
    bias  = mean(temp_loca - temp_gridmet, na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse  = sqrt(mean((temp_loca - temp_gridmet)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
]


bad_dif <- dt[
  ,
  .(
    n    = .N,
    cor  = cor(temp_loca, temp_gridmet, use = "complete.obs"),
    rmse = sqrt(mean((temp_loca - temp_gridmet)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    bias = mean(temp_loca - temp_gridmet, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = wsd_source_id
][order(-rmse)]



viewer <- temp_comp %>%
  left_join(water_supplies %>% select(wsd_source_id, region, geometry), by = "wsd_source_id")


viewer %>%
  mutate(mean_temp = (temp_loca + temp_gridmet) / 2,
         diff = temp_loca - temp_gridmet) %>%
  ggplot(aes(mean_temp, diff, color = region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(x = "Mean of LOCA and gridMET (°C)",
       y = "LOCA − gridMET (°C)")

lims <- range(
  c(viewer$temp_loca, viewer$temp_gridmet),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_by_region <- viewer %>%
  filter(!is.na(temp_loca), !is.na(temp_gridmet)) %>%
  count(region)

ggplot(viewer) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = temp_loca, y = temp_gridmet, color = region)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ region, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = lims) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = lims) +
  coord_equal() +
  geom_text(data = n_by_region,
            aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
            x = -Inf, y = Inf,
            hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.1,
            inherit.aes = FALSE)


# Statistical test of "interchangeability": TOST equivalence  (Overall and by region) on paired differences

# overall paired difference package
library(TOSTER)

eq_bounds <- 0.5  # °C (pick your practical bound)

diff_all <- with(viewer, temp_loca - temp_gridmet)
diff_all <- diff_all[!is.na(diff_all)]

tost_all <- tsum_TOST(m1 = mean(diff_all),
                      sd1 = sd(diff_all),
                      n1 = length(diff_all),
                      mu = 0,                   
                      low_eqbound = -eq_bounds,
                      high_eqbound =  eq_bounds,
                      eqbound_type = "raw",
                      alpha = 0.05)
tost_all
```

It is a one-sample TOST equivalence test (TOST = Two One-Sided Tests), which tests whether the mean difference between LOCA and gridMET temperatures falls within a pre-defined practical equivalence range (±0.5 °C), meaning the two datasets can be considered practically equivalent rather than exactly the same. Using a ±0.5 °C tolerance, the average temperature difference between LOCA and gridMET is small enough that the two datasets can be treated as effectively the same for this analysis. (That said, LOCA temperatures are consistently about 0.32 °C cooler than gridMET on average so we could bias-correct?)

Regional test:
```{r}
tost_by_region <- viewer %>%
  filter(!is.na(temp_loca), !is.na(temp_gridmet)) %>%
  mutate(diff = temp_loca - temp_gridmet) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(diff)),
    mean_diff = mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_diff   = sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    tost = list(
      tsum_TOST(
        m1 = mean_diff,
        sd1 = sd_diff,
        n1 = n,
        mu = 0,
        low_eqbound  = -eq_bounds,
        high_eqbound =  eq_bounds,
        eqbound_type = "raw",
        alpha = 0.05
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


eq_bounds <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05

tost_by_region_summary <- tost_by_region %>%
  mutate(
    se = sd_diff / sqrt(n),
    df = n - 1,
    
    # NHST: mean diff == 0 (two-sided)
    t_nhst = mean_diff / se,
    nhst_p = 2 * pt(-abs(t_nhst), df = df),
    
    # TOST: H0: mean <= -b  OR mean >= +b
    t_lower = (mean_diff - (-eq_bounds)) / se,   # test mean > -b
    t_upper = (mean_diff - ( eq_bounds)) / se,   # test mean < +b
    
    tost_p_lower = 1 - pt(t_lower, df = df),
    tost_p_upper = pt(t_upper, df = df),
    
    equivalent = (tost_p_lower < alpha) & (tost_p_upper < alpha)
  ) %>%
  select(region, n, mean_diff, sd_diff, nhst_p, tost_p_lower, tost_p_upper, equivalent)

```

"Bias-correction"? We could create a bias-corrected gridMET to match LOCA by adding the region-specific mean difference (LOCA − gridMET) to gridMET; after correction, the mean LOCA–gridMET difference within each region was effectively zero (around 10e-15 Celsius per region), confirming the offset was removed while preserving variability.
```{r}
region_offsets <- viewer %>%
  filter(!is.na(temp_loca), !is.na(temp_gridmet)) %>%
  mutate(diff = temp_loca - temp_gridmet) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean_diff = mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_diff   = sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")


viewer_repl <- viewer %>%
  left_join(region_offsets %>% select(region, mean_diff), by = "region") %>%
  mutate(temp_gridmet_loca_eq = temp_gridmet + mean_diff)

viewer_repl %>%
  filter(!is.na(temp_loca), !is.na(temp_gridmet_loca_eq)) %>%
  mutate(diff_after = temp_loca - temp_gridmet_loca_eq) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize(mean_after = mean(diff_after),
            sd_after   = sd(diff_after),
            .groups = "drop")

viewer_repl %>%
  mutate(mean_temp = (temp_loca + temp_gridmet_loca_eq) / 2,
         diff = temp_loca - temp_gridmet_loca_eq) %>%
  ggplot(aes(mean_temp, diff, color = region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(x = "Mean of LOCA and LOCA-fixed gridMET (°C)",
       y = "LOCA − LOCA-fixed gridMET (°C)") +
  facet_wrap(~region)


ggplot(viewer_repl) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = temp_loca, y = temp_gridmet_loca_eq, color = region)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ region, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = lims) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = lims) +
  coord_equal() +
  geom_text(data = n_by_region,
            aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
            x = -Inf, y = Inf,
            hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.1,
            inherit.aes = FALSE)

```

##### Relate temperature to visitation

```{r}
historical_temp <- unique(water_supplies$wsd_source_id) %>%
  map(~try({
    
    list.files("data/dissertation/gridmet_temperature_water_supplies/", pattern = paste(.x), full.names = TRUE) %>%
      map_dfr(~read_parquet(.x)) %>%
      group_by(month) %>%
      summarize(tmean_C = mean(tmean_C, na.rm = TRUE),
                n_points = n()) %>%
      mutate(wsd_source_id = .x) 
    
  })) %>%
  keep(tibble::is_tibble) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  left_join(water_supplies %>% select(wsd_source_id, region, geometry), by = "wsd_source_id") %>%
  left_join(region_offsets %>% select(region, mean_diff), by = "region")  %>%
  mutate(mean_temp = tmean_C + mean_diff) %>%
  mutate(UnitCode = str_sub(wsd_source_id, 1, 4),
         ym = as.character(month),
         month = ym(month)) %>%
  select(UnitCode, ym, wsd_source_id, mean_temp)

visitation <- unique(historical_temp$UnitCode) %>%
  map_dfr(~get_unit_visitation(units = .x, startYear = 2010, endYear = 2024)) %>%
  mutate(ym = npswava::make_ym(ym(paste0(Year, "-", Month)))) %>%
  group_by(UnitCode, ym, Year, Month) %>%
  summarize(RecreationVisitors = sum(RecreationVisitors, na.rm = TRUE))

# peak historical monthly average visitation per park, for caps
historic_average_cap <- visitation %>%
  group_by(UnitCode, Month) %>%
  summarize(avg_visit = mean(RecreationVisitors, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  filter(avg_visit == max(avg_visit)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(visit_cap_upper = avg_visit * 1.25,  # High = looser ceiling (+25%)
         visit_cap_lower = avg_visit * 1.05) %>%   # Low  = tighter ceiling (+5%)
  select(UnitCode, visit_cap_upper, visit_cap_lower)

# fit NULL model, linear, quadratic, and cubic models for each park. select best by BIC
fit_and_select <- function(df
) {
  long_enough <- nrow(df) >= 4*12 &&
    sum(!is.na(df$RecreationVisitors)) >= 4*12 &&
    sum(!is.na(df$mean_temp)) >= 4*12
  if (!long_enough) {
    return(tibble(model_name = "null",
                  bic = NA_real_,
                  adj_r2 = NA_real_,
                  model = list(lm(RecreationVisitors ~ 1, data = df))))
  }
  
  models <- list(null = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ 1, data = df),
                 linear = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ mean_temp, data = df),
                 quadratic = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ poly(mean_temp, 2, raw = TRUE), data = df),
                 cubic = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ poly(mean_temp, 3, raw = TRUE), data = df))
  
  stats <- tibble(model_name = names(models),
                  model = unname(models),
                  bic = map_dbl(models, BIC),
                  # for r2, record NA_real_ if nothing is returned.
                  # otherwise, convert the adjusted r2 to a plain numeric value.
                  adj_r2 = map_dbl(models, function(m){
                    val <- suppressWarnings(broom::glance(m)$adj.r.squared)
                    if (length(val) == 0 || is.na(val)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(val)
                  })
  ) %>%
    slice_min(bic, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  return(stats)
}

park_models <- historical_temp %>%
  inner_join(., visitation, by = c("UnitCode", "ym")) %>%
  group_by(wsd_source_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_and_select(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(temp_in_model = model_name != "null",
         temp_sensitive = temp_in_model & !is.na(adj_r2) & adj_r2 >= 0.5)

# predict for all parks:
predict_one_park <- function(mod, newdf) {
  if (nrow(newdf) == 0) return(newdf %>% mutate(.pred = numeric(0)))
  newdf %>% mutate(.pred = as.numeric(predict(mod, newdata = newdf)))
}

# hindcast data

  filter(!is.na(wsd_source_id), !is.na(ym), !is.na(mean_temp)) %>%
  nest(data = c(ym, mean_temp, RecreationVisitors)) %>%
  left_join(park_models %>% 
              select(wsd_source_id, model_name, bic, adj_r2, model, temp_sensitive),
            by = "wsd_source_id") %>%
  mutate(pred = map2(model, data, predict_one_park)) %>%
  select(wsd_source_id, model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive, pred) %>%
  unnest(pred) %>%
  transmute(wsd_source_id, ym, # year, month,
            model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive,
            Pred_High = .pred,   
            Pred_Low = .pred)
```

##### Find extreme models per water supply
```{r}
combined_data <- read_parquet("data/dissertation/loca2_temp_nps_water_supplies.parquet") %>%
  data.table::as.data.table() 
combined_data[
  ,
  c("model", "ssp", "run") := tstrsplit(model, "\\.")
]

setnames(combined_data, "model", "model_full")

combined_data[
  , c("model", "ssp", "run") := tstrsplit(model_full, "\\.")
]

# distinct (model, scenario) pairs that exist in the past and future
ssps <- combined_data %>%
  filter(ssp != "historical") %>%
  distinct(model, ssp, run)

temperature_change_sub <- vector("list", length = nrow(ssps))

for(i in 1:nrow(ssps)){
  
  ssp_sub <- ssps[i,]
  
  hindcast <- combined_data %>%
    filter(model == ssp_sub$model,
           ssp == "historical" | (ssp == ssp_sub$ssp & year(date) <= 2025),
           run == ssp_sub$run) %>%
    filter(year(date) <= 2025)
  
  future <- combined_data %>%
    filter(model == ssp_sub$model,
           ssp == ssp_sub$ssp,
           run == ssp_sub$run) %>%
    filter(year(date) >= 2035 & year(date) <= 2065)
  
  historical_stat <- hindcast %>%
    group_by(wsd_source_id, park_unit) %>%
    summarize(temperature_historical = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
              range_historical = paste0(min(year(date)), "-", end = max(year(date))))
  
  future_stat <- future %>% 
    group_by(wsd_source_id, park_unit) %>%
    summarize(temperature_future = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
              range_future = paste0(min(year(date)), "-", end = max(year(date))))
  
  temperature_change_sub[[i]] <- future_stat %>%
    inner_join(., historical_stat, by = c("wsd_source_id", "park_unit")) %>%
    mutate(model = ssp_sub$model,
           ssp = ssp_sub$ssp,
           run = ssp_sub$run,
           temperature_change = temperature_future - temperature_historical,
           percent_change = (temperature_change / temperature_historical) * 100)
}

temperature_change <- bind_rows(temperature_change_sub)


# calculate percentile indicators:
suppressMessages({suppressWarnings({
  
  p10_values <- temperature_change %>%
    group_by(park_unit, wsd_source_id) %>%
    mutate(p10 = quantile(percent_change, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
           diff_from_p10 = abs(percent_change - p10)) %>%
    filter(diff_from_p10 == min(diff_from_p10, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%  # take first if ties
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(model_p10 = paste(model, ssp, run, sep = ".")) %>%
    select(wsd_source_id,
           park_unit,
           raw_temperature_change_p10 = percent_change,
           model_p10)
  
  p50_values <- temperature_change %>%
    group_by(park_unit, wsd_source_id) %>%
    mutate(p50 = median(percent_change, na.rm = TRUE),
           diff_from_p50 = abs(percent_change - p50)) %>%
    filter(diff_from_p50 == min(diff_from_p50, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%  # take first if ties
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(model_p50 = paste(model, ssp, run, sep = ".")) %>%
    select(wsd_source_id,
           park_unit,
           raw_temperature_change_p50 = percent_change,
           model_p50)
  
  p90_values <- temperature_change %>%
    group_by(park_unit, wsd_source_id) %>%
    mutate(p90 = quantile(percent_change, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
           diff_from_p90 = abs(percent_change - p90)) %>%
    filter(diff_from_p90 == min(diff_from_p90, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%  # take first if ties
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(model_p90 = paste(model, ssp, run, sep = ".")) %>%
    select(wsd_source_id,
           park_unit,
           raw_temperature_change_p90 = percent_change,
           model_p90)
  
})})

# Combine all indicators using standardized joins
temp_model_list <- p10_values %>%
  left_join(p50_values, by = c("wsd_source_id", "park_unit")) %>%
  left_join(p90_values, by = c("wsd_source_id", "park_unit")) %>%
  left_join(water_supplies %>% select(wsd_source_id, park_name), by = "wsd_source_id") %>%
  # reorder columns following standardized pattern
  select(wsd_source_id, park_unit, park_name, everything())
```

```{r new way, eval = FALSE}
# fit NULL model, linear, quadratic, and cubic models for each park. select best by BIC
fit_and_select <- function(df) {
  long_enough <- nrow(df) >= 14*12 &&
    sum(!is.na(df$RecreationVisitors)) >= 14*12 &&
    sum(!is.na(df$tmean_C)) >= 14*12
  if (!long_enough) {
    return(tibble(model_name = "null",
                  bic = NA_real_,
                  adj_r2 = NA_real_,
                  model = list(lm(RecreationVisitors ~ 1, data = df))))
  }
  
  models <- list(null = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ 1, data = df),
                 linear = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ tmean_C, data = df),
                 quadratic = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ poly(tmean_C, 2, raw = TRUE), data = df),
                 cubic = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ poly(tmean_C, 3, raw = TRUE), data = df))
  
  stats <- tibble(model_name = names(models),
                  model = unname(models),
                  bic = map_dbl(models, BIC),
                  # for r2, record NA_real_ if nothing is returned.
                  # otherwise, convert the adjusted r2 to a plain numeric value.
                  adj_r2 = map_dbl(models, function(m){
                    val <- suppressWarnings(broom::glance(m)$adj.r.squared)
                    if (length(val) == 0 || is.na(val)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(val)
                  })
  ) %>%
    slice_min(bic, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  return(stats)
}

park_models <- historic_data %>%
  group_by(park_unit) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_and_select(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(temp_in_model = model_name != "null",
         temp_sensitive = temp_in_model & !is.na(adj_r2) & adj_r2 >= 0.5)

# predict for all parks:
predict_one_park <- function(mod, newdf) {
  if (nrow(newdf) == 0) return(newdf %>% mutate(.pred = numeric(0)))
  newdf %>% mutate(.pred = as.numeric(predict(mod, newdata = newdf)))
}

# hindcast data
historic_hindcasts <- historic_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(park_unit), !is.na(month), !is.na(tmean_C)) %>%
  nest(data = c(ym, year, month, tmean_C)) %>%
  left_join(park_models %>% 
              select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, model, temp_sensitive),
            by = "park_unit") %>%
  mutate(pred = map2(model, data, predict_one_park)) %>%
  select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive, pred) %>%
  unnest(pred) %>%
  transmute(park_unit, ym, year, month,
            model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive,
            Pred_High = .pred,   
            Pred_Low = .pred)

# future predictions data
future_predictions <- future_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(park_unit), !is.na(month), !is.na(tmean_C)) %>%
  nest(data = c(ym, year, month, tmean_C)) %>%
  left_join(park_models %>% 
              select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, model, temp_sensitive),
            by = "park_unit") %>%
  filter(!is.na(bic)) %>%  # keep parks with a selected model
  mutate(pred = map2(model, data, predict_one_park)) %>%
  select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive, pred) %>%
  unnest(pred) %>%
  left_join(historic_average_cap, by = "park_unit") %>%
  mutate(Pred_High = pmin(.pred, visit_cap_upper),  # looser ceiling (+25%)
         Pred_Low = pmin(.pred, visit_cap_lower)) %>%   # tighter ceiling (+5%)
  select(park_unit, ym, year, month, model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive, Pred_High, Pred_Low)

# aggregate annual vals
annual_hindcast <- historic_hindcasts %>%

  summarize(Pred_High = sum(Pred_High, na.rm = TRUE),
            Pred_Low = sum(Pred_Low,  na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(period = "hindcast")

annual_future <- future_predictions %>%
```

```{r old way, eval = FALSE}
                  bic = map_dbl(models, BIC),
                  # for r2, record NA_real_ if nothing is returned.
                  # otherwise, convert the adjusted r2 to a plain numeric value.
                  adj_r2 = map_dbl(models, function(m){
                    val <- suppressWarnings(broom::glance(m)$adj.r.squared)
                    if (length(val) == 0 || is.na(val)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(val)
                  })
  ) %>%
    slice_min(bic, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  return(stats)
}

park_models <- historic_data %>%
  group_by(park_unit) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_and_select(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(temp_in_model = model_name != "null",
         temp_sensitive = temp_in_model & !is.na(adj_r2) & adj_r2 >= 0.5)

# predict for all parks:
predict_one_park <- function(mod, newdf) {
  if (nrow(newdf) == 0) return(newdf %>% mutate(.pred = numeric(0)))
  newdf %>% mutate(.pred = as.numeric(predict(mod, newdata = newdf)))
}

# hindcast data
historic_hindcasts <- historic_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(park_unit), !is.na(month), !is.na(tmean_C)) %>%
  nest(data = c(ym, year, month, tmean_C)) %>%
  left_join(park_models %>% 
              select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, model, temp_sensitive),
            by = "park_unit") %>%
  mutate(pred = map2(model, data, predict_one_park)) %>%
  select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive, pred) %>%
  unnest(pred) %>%
  transmute(park_unit, ym, year, month,
            model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive,
            Pred_High = .pred,   
            Pred_Low = .pred)

# future predictions data
future_predictions <- future_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(park_unit), !is.na(month), !is.na(tmean_C)) %>%
  nest(data = c(ym, year, month, tmean_C)) %>%
  left_join(park_models %>% 
              select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, model, temp_sensitive),
            by = "park_unit") %>%
  filter(!is.na(bic)) %>%  # keep parks with a selected model
  mutate(pred = map2(model, data, predict_one_park)) %>%
  select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive, pred) %>%
  unnest(pred) %>%
  left_join(historic_average_cap, by = "park_unit") %>%
  mutate(Pred_High = pmin(.pred, visit_cap_upper),  # looser ceiling (+25%)
         Pred_Low = pmin(.pred, visit_cap_lower)) %>%   # tighter ceiling (+5%)
  select(park_unit, ym, year, month, model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive, Pred_High, Pred_Low)

# aggregate annual vals
annual_hindcast <- historic_hindcasts %>%
  group_by(park_unit, year) %>%
  summarize(Pred_High = sum(Pred_High, na.rm = TRUE),
            Pred_Low = sum(Pred_Low,  na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(period = "hindcast")

annual_future <- future_predictions %>%
  group_by(park_unit, year) %>%
  summarize(Pred_High = sum(Pred_High, na.rm = TRUE),
            Pred_Low = sum(Pred_Low,  na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(period = "future")

annual_observed <- historic_data %>%
  group_by(park_unit, year) %>%
  summarize(Observed = sum(RecreationVisitors, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

annual_pred <- bind_rows(annual_hindcast, annual_future)


top_park <- "GRTE" # park_models %>% arrange(desc(adj_r2)) %>% slice(1) %>% pull(park_unit)

plot_df <- annual_pred %>%
  filter(park_unit == top_park) %>%
  select(park_unit, year, period, Pred_High, Pred_Low) %>%
  left_join(annual_observed %>% 
              filter(park_unit == top_park),
            by = c("park_unit","year"))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Pred_High, linetype = period)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Pred_Low,  linetype = period)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Observed), color = "blue") +
  labs(title = paste0(top_park, ": Observed vs. Modeled Visitation"),
       y = "Annual visitation",
       linetype = "Prediction period") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# making the exposure indicators
baseline_obs <- annual_observed %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  transmute(park_unit, Reference_Observed = Observed)

targets_2050 <- annual_future %>%
  filter(year == 2050) %>%
  rename(Future_Temperature_High = Pred_High,
         Future_Temperature_Low = Pred_Low) %>%
  select(park_unit, year, Future_Temperature_High, Future_Temperature_Low)

fut_temp_indicators <- targets_2050 %>%
  left_join(baseline_obs, by = "park_unit") %>%
  mutate(Year_Future = year,
         Year_Reference = 2025L,
         # percent change from 2050 vs observed 2025
         high_percent_change_raw_real = (Future_Temperature_High - Reference_Observed) / Reference_Observed,
         low_percent_change_raw_real  = (Future_Temperature_Low  - Reference_Observed) / Reference_Observed) %>%
  add_standardized_indicators(prefix = "percent_change")
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Fisichelli et al. (2015) — Historical models
# Assessments of future potential changes in visitation were limited to parks with temperature as an explanatory variable in the best-fit historical model and an adjusted R2 ≥ 0.5.
# Kristen's stored data:
load("~/Desktop/0_my_git/nps_water_vulnerability/data/all/Visitation_Projection/Explore_Visitation_Temperature.RData")


#`all_dat` is object she stored with all necessary historical info
# climate_future is the object stored with all necessary future info

# ...remove all else:
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("all_dat", "climate_future")))

source("setup.R")

historic_data <- all_dat %>% 
  rename(month = Month, year = Year) %>%
  select(ym, year, month, park_unit, RecreationVisitors, tmean_C)

historic_average_cap <- historic_data %>%
  group_by(park_unit, month) %>%
  summarize(avg_visit = mean(RecreationVisitors, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(park_unit) %>%
  filter(avg_visit == max(avg_visit)) %>%
  mutate(visit_cap_upper = avg_visit * 1.25,
         visit_cap_lower = avg_visit * 1.05) %>%
  select(park_unit, visit_cap_upper, visit_cap_lower)

future_data <- climate_future %>%
  mutate(year = year((ym)),
         month = month((ym))) %>%
  select(ym, year, month, park_unit, tmean_C)


# fit NULL model, linear, quadratic, and cubic models for each park. select best by BIC
fit_and_select <- function(df) {
  
  # return NA if not enough monthly data
  if (nrow(df) < 14*12 || sum(!is.na(df$RecreationVisitors)) < 14*12 || sum(!is.na(df$tmean_C)) < 14*12) {
    return(tibble(
      model_name = "null",
      bic = NA_real_,
      adj_r2 = NA_real_,
      model = list(lm(RecreationVisitors ~ 1, data = df))
    ))
  }
  
  # create lm of visitation against linear, quadratic, and cubic temperature
  models <- list(null = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ 1, data = df),
                 linear = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ tmean_C, data = df),
                 quadratic = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ poly(tmean_C, 2, raw = TRUE), data = df),
                 cubic = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ poly(tmean_C, 3, raw = TRUE), data = df))
  
  stats <- tibble(model_name = names(models),
                  model = unname(models),
                  bic = map_dbl(models, ~ BIC(.x)),
                  adj_r2 = map_dbl(models, ~ suppressWarnings(broom::glance(.x)$adj.r.squared %||% NA_real_))) %>%
    slice_min(bic, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  
  return(stats)
  
}

park_models <- historic_data %>%
  group_by(park_unit) %>%
  # claude told me about this - it's a map for grouped data
  group_modify(~ fit_and_select(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(temp_in_model = model != "Null",
         temp_sensitive = temp_in_model & adj_r2 >= 0.5)

# plot for the best-fitting park
example_data <- historic_data %>%
  filter(park_unit == park_models %>% arrange(desc(adj_r2)) %>% slice(1) %>% pull(park_unit)) %>%
  select(tmean_C, RecreationVisitors) %>%
  arrange(tmean_C)

best_model <- park_models %>% filter(park_unit == park_models %>% arrange(desc(adj_r2)) %>% slice(1) %>% pull(park_unit)) %>% pull(model_name)

best_fit <- switch(best_model,
                   "null" = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ 1, data = example_data),
                   "linear"  = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ tmean_C, data = example_data),
                   "quadratic"  = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ poly(tmean_C, 2, raw = TRUE), data = example_data),
                   "cubic"  = lm(RecreationVisitors ~ poly(tmean_C, 3, raw = TRUE), data = example_data))

example_pred <- example_data %>%
  mutate(yhat = predict(best_fit, newdata = example_data))

ggplot(example_pred, aes(x = tmean_C, y = RecreationVisitors)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = yhat)) +
  labs(title = sprintf("%s: %s (Adj R² = %.2f)",
                       park_models %>% arrange(desc(adj_r2)) %>% slice(1) %>% pull(park_unit), best_model, broom::glance(best_fit)$adj.r.squared),
       x = "Monthly mean air temperature (°C)",
       y = "Monthly visitation") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# apply each park’s best model to its future temps

predict_one_park <- function(mod, newdf) {
  # newdf needs tmean_C column even for null model (predict ignores it)
  if (nrow(newdf) == 0) return(newdf %>% mutate(.pred = numeric(0)))
  newdf %>%
    mutate(.pred = as.numeric(predict(mod, newdata = newdf)))
}


# split future data by park, join in the model, predict, and bind back
future_predictions <- future_data %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(park_unit), !is.na(month), !is.na(tmean_C)) %>%
  nest(data = c(tmean_C)) %>%
  left_join(park_models %>% select(park_unit, model_name, bic, adj_r2, model, temp_sensitive),
            by = "park_unit") %>%
  filter(!is.na(bic)) %>%
  # safely handle any weird model issues
  mutate(pred = map2(model, data, ~ predict_one_park(.x, .y)),
         .keep = "all") %>%
  select(park_unit, ym, year, month, model_name, bic, adj_r2, temp_sensitive, pred) %>%
  unnest(pred) %>%
  left_join(historic_average_cap, by = "park_unit") %>%
  mutate(Future_Temperature_High = ifelse(.pred >= visit_cap_upper, visit_cap_upper, .pred),
         Future_Temperature_Low = ifelse(.pred >= visit_cap_lower, visit_cap_lower, .pred)) %>%
  select(-.pred)

predictions <- future_predictions %>%
  bind_rows(historic_data %>%
              rename(Future_Temperature_High = RecreationVisitors) %>%
              mutate(Future_Temperature_Low = Future_Temperature_High)) %>%
  group_by(park_unit, year) %>%
  summarize(Future_Temperature_High = sum(Future_Temperature_High, na.rm = TRUE),
            Future_Temperature_Low = sum(Future_Temperature_Low, na.rm = TRUE))

fut_temp_indicators <- predictions %>%
  filter(year == 2050) %>%
  left_join(., historic_data %>%
              group_by(park_unit, year) %>%
              summarize(Reference_Observed = sum(RecreationVisitors, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
              filter(year == 2025),
            by = "park_unit") %>%
  rename(Year_Future = year.x, Year_Reference = year.y) %>%
  left_join(., predictions %>% filter(year == 2025) %>%
              select(park_unit,
                     Reference_Temperature_High = Future_Temperature_High,
                     Reference_Temperature_Low = Future_Temperature_Low),
            by = "park_unit") %>%
  mutate(high_percent_change_raw_real = (Future_Temperature_High - Reference_Observed) / Reference_Observed,
         low_percent_change_raw_real = (Future_Temperature_Low - Reference_Observed) / Reference_Observed,
         high_percent_change_raw_predict = (Future_Temperature_High - Reference_Temperature_High) / Reference_Temperature_High,
         low_percent_change_raw_predict = (Future_Temperature_Low - Reference_Temperature_Low) / Reference_Temperature_Low) %>%
  add_standardized_indicators(., prefix = "percent_change")


ggplotly(ggplot(predictions %>% filter(park_unit == "GRTE")) +
           geom_line(aes(x = year, y = Future_Temperature_High)) +
           geom_line(aes(x = year, y = Future_Temperature_Low)) +

                       filter(park_unit == "GRTE") %>%

                       summarize(Reference_Observed = sum(RecreationVisitors, na.rm = TRUE)), aes(x = year, y = Reference_Observed),
                     color = "blue")
)
```
